items.q: E. C. he come there, that's all I can remember.

ctx.x: You were about to recall if you could that bit.

That bit would be with E.C. I couldn't think what it would be just to save my soul. That's hard for me to that's hard for me to think of, man. That's so far back. E. C. he come there, that's all I can remember. He come there. No, I can't think of that bit. Don't strike me at all.
Now, where do I go from there.
